//: Your Herdr board rules. Every list here is ADDED to the package's defaults (defaults.json, in the board mod's folder: mods/veroboard/agent/core); blocked.disable switches built-in rules off by id (ids: top of mods/veroboard/agent/core/rules.js). Changes apply on each agent's next status-line run.

people.//names: Only these people count as someone an agent waits on ('Blocked · Luke'). Empty: any capitalized name does. Agents (t22) always count. Example: ["Luke", "Sam"]
people.//notPeople: Tools, bots and models: 'waiting on Devin' is background work, not a person. Example: ["Devin", "Jenkins"]

blocked.//asks: Phrases near the end of an agent's message that mean it waits for you (Blocked · You). Example: ["your thoughts"]
blocked.//notAsks: Phrases that make a sentence not an ask. Example: ["just FYI"]
blocked.//nothingForYou: Phrases that say you have nothing to do: never Blocked · You. Example: ["all quiet on your side"]
blocked.//todoLabels: Line-start labels that hand you a to-do. Example: ["action item"] for 'Action item: rotate the key'
blocked.//disable: Built-in rule ids to switch off. Example: ["paste", "question"]

board.//: How the board looks (Veroboard settings → Board, Card and Notifications). Leave a setting out to use the package default. Every setting, its key and its default: the README's Configure section.
board.//card: What each card shows and where (Veroboard settings → Card). Easiest to set in the dialog. Shape: {"lines": [{"left": [], "right": []} ×3], "hidden": [], "rowKinds": {"task": true, "shell": true, "monitor": true}}; badge ids: laneTime, why, launched, address, openedBy (hidden by default), folder, branch, model, effort, window, space, context.
board.//top: The top bar (Veroboard settings → Board). Shape: {"lines": [{"left": [], "right": []}], "hidden": []}; item ids: gear (can't be hidden), bell, filter, divider (added ones: divider2, divider3, …), spaces, newSpace, count, pie.
